More clarity on specific contributions of the paper. Explaining the limitations/assumptions and potential reasons behind specific findings would be useful."

Similarly, "Explaining the limitations/assumptions and potential reasons behind specific findings would be useful" is explicit but vague on how.

So the gold label of 3 seems correct: explicit actions but vague on execution.

The rationale claims 5, arguing that the actions are "specific and actionable, giving the authors clear directions on what to modify" and "concrete details on how to implement them." This is a misapplication — the comment doesn't provide concrete details on HOW to implement (e.g., which sections to revise, what specific comparisons to add, what specific limitations to discuss). The rationale overstates the concreteness.

So the rationale supports the wrong score (5 instead of 3). The answer is `supports_wrong_score`.
